# Refine

> > Refine is an AI-powered, open-source React framework for rapidly building enterprise-grade internal tools, admin panels, and B2B applications with built-in security, authentication, and low-code capabilities.

Refine combines React development with AI assistance to streamline the creation of complex internal tools and dashboards. The platform is backed by Y Combinator and 500 Emerging Europe, offering both open-source and commercial options with enterprise security features including RBAC, ABAC, and multiple identity providers.

## Key Topics

- React Framework
- Internal Tools
- Enterprise Security
- Admin Dashboard
- Low-Code Platform
- Open Source
- AI-Powered Development
- RBAC/ABAC
- Identity Management
- Supabase
- REST APIs
- Self-Hosted
- CRM Platform
- Okta
- Azure AD

## Core Products

- [Refine Core: Open-Source Retool For Enterprise](https://refine.dev/core): Open-source React framework for building enterprise admin panels and internal tools with low-code capabilities and enterprise security features.
- [Refine: Build Enterprise Grade Internal Tools With AI](https://refine.dev): Homepage showcasing Refine's AI-powered platform for rapidly building enterprise internal tools and B2B applications.

## Getting Started

- [Getting Started with Refine](https://refine.dev/start): Quick-start guide for building with Refine, React, Supabase, and REST APIs to create your first internal tool.
